WITH date_dim_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM date_dim_range dd
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM date_dim_range dd
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
web_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM date_dim_range dd
    INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
all_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_customers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_customers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_customers
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM all_customers
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
